newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes lower on dollar buying.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes lower on dollar buying.

text.p: Cheaper call money prompted banks to hoard the U.S. currency for higher interest gains, pushing the Bangladesh taka to a weaker 42.5350/5450 close against the dollar, dealers said.
"There was buying (of dollars) by importers. But some banks also bought for higher interest gains with call money tumbling," said one dealer.
Call money rates ended at 4.0 to 4.25 percent against the previous 4.25-4.5 percent, after 2.3 billion taka in maturing central bank bills entered the market on Saturday.
